about-me-section.intro-text: Hi, I'm Nico Leiteritz! I love building clean, efficient software. Inspired by the rapid evolution of technology, I enjoy turning complex ideas into structured, user-friendly digital experiences.
about-me-section.location-text: Based in Germany, I am open to both in-house office roles and remote collaborations, or even relocating for the right opportunity.
about-me-section.mindset-text: I thrive on continuous learning, constantly mastering new frameworks to stay ahead and write efficient, maintainable code.
about-me-section.puzzle-text: I view challenges as puzzles, always aiming for the most scalable and elegant solution possible.

skills-overview.description-text: I build modern web apps, focusing on Angular and TypeScript. My expertise includes data-driven development, integrating REST-APIs and Supabase. By prioritizing clean code and intuitive design, I ensure my projects are both performant and accessible.
skills-overview.cta-text: I am genuinely passionate about exploring new technologies. If your project requires a tool outside my current stack, I am highly motivated to quickly adapt and master new systems to grow with your challenges.

privacy-policy.headline: Privacy Policy
privacy-policy.sec1-gen-text: The following notes provide a simple overview of what happens to your personal data when you visit this website. Personal data is any data that can be used to personally identify you. Detailed information can be found in our privacy policy below.
privacy-policy.sec1-coll-text1: Who is responsible for data collection on this website? Data processing on this website is carried out by the website operator. Their contact details can be found in the section 'Notice concerning the responsible entity' in this privacy policy.
privacy-policy.sec1-coll-text2: How do we collect your data? Your data is collected when you provide it to us, e.g., via a contact form. Other data is collected automatically by our IT systems when you visit the website (e.g., internet browser, operating system, or time of access).
privacy-policy.sec1-coll-text3: What do we use your data for? Some data is collected to ensure error-free provision of the website. Other data may be used to analyze your user behavior.
privacy-policy.sec1-coll-text4: What rights do you have regarding your data? You have the right at any time to obtain information free of charge about the origin, recipient, and purpose of your stored personal data. You also have the right to request correction or deletion of this data.
privacy-policy.sec2-host-text: We host our website with Hetzner Online GmbH. The provider is Hetzner Online GmbH, Industriestr. 25, 91152 Pleinfeld, Germany (hereinafter Hetzner). When you visit our website, Hetzner collects various server log files including your IP addresses. For details, please see Hetzner's privacy policy: https://www.hetzner.com/legal/privacy-policy/. The use of Hetzner is based on Art. 6 (1) (f) GDPR. We have a legitimate interest in the most reliable presentation of our website.
privacy-policy.sec3-prot-text: The operators of these pages take the protection of your personal data very seriously. We treat your personal data confidentially and in accordance with the statutory data protection regulations and this privacy policy.
privacy-policy.sec3-resp-text: The responsible entity for data processing on this website is: Nico Leiteritz, Herzoggraben 16b, 84405 Dorfen. Email: kontakt@nico-leiteritz.de. The responsible entity is the natural or legal person who alone or jointly with others decides on the purposes and means of processing personal data.
privacy-policy.sec3-stor-text: Unless a more specific storage period has been specified in this privacy policy, your personal data will remain with us until the purpose for the data processing no longer applies.
privacy-policy.sec3-rev-sub: Revocation of your consent to data processing
privacy-policy.sec3-rev-text: Many data processing operations are only possible with your explicit consent. You can revoke consent you have already given at any time.
privacy-policy.sec3-obj-sub: Right to object to data collection (Art. 21 GDPR)
privacy-policy.sec3-obj-text: IF DATA PROCESSING IS CARRIED OUT ON THE BASIS OF ART. 6 (1) LIT. E OR F GDPR, YOU HAVE THE RIGHT TO OBJECT TO THE PROCESSING OF YOUR PERSONAL DATA AT ANY TIME.
privacy-policy.sec3-com-text: In the event of violations of the GDPR, data subjects have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
privacy-policy.sec3-ssl-text: This site uses SSL or TLS encryption for security reasons and to protect the transmission of confidential content. You can recognize an encrypted connection by the lock symbol in your browser.
privacy-policy.sec4-log-text: The provider of the pages automatically collects and stores information in so-called server log files, which your browser automatically transmits to us.
privacy-policy.sec4-mail-sub: Inquiry by e-mail or contact form
privacy-policy.sec4-mail-text: If you contact us by e-mail or via a contact form, your inquiry, including all resulting personal data, will be stored and processed by us for the purpose of processing your request.
privacy-policy.sec5-font-text: This site uses so-called Google Fonts for the uniform display of fonts, which are installed locally. A connection to Google servers does not take place.
